picks.editorial_note: A $53M ARPA-H award for an MIT-led team to develop safer, AI-designed herbicide alternatives is a major federal investment in generative AI for agricultural chemistry with direct real-world impact.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle is a rare example of a single AI model generalizing across wildly different physical phenomena, from granular flow to protein folding, a notable step toward general-purpose physics simulators.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, demonstrating real translational potential for pandemic preparedness.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Up to 20 million euros in German federal funding for TUM's new mobility center signals serious government commitment to AI-driven autonomous public transportation infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's 'Workspace Models' solve a key bottleneck in robot learning, letting robots recall relevant past observations without expensive re-exploration, with broad applicability to real-world robotics.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: A formal MoU and planned joint lab between HKUST and robotics firm Unitree ties leading academic AI research directly to a commercial embodied-AI and humanoid robotics pipeline.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership aims to industrialize sovereign AI and robotics research, a notable academia-industry bridge for European AI sovereignty efforts.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: A Northeastern analysis linking Nvidia's CEO to a suspected espionage-related relationship raises direct national-security policy questions for the AI chip industry's most consequential company.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: A $4.2M NIST award for SMU's Digital Twin Technology Lab links AI and HPC to semiconductor manufacturing and workforce training, a concrete federal investment in AI-enabled domestic chip capacity.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led effort combining satellite imagery, health data, and AI to probe environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia represents a significant application of AI to a major public-health challenge.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University
